title: NCAA: Rubico powers LPU past Perpetual to end skid
summary: Matthew Rubico starred as Lyceum of the Philippines University took down University of Perpetual Help, 98-89, in NCAA Season 102 men’s basketball on Tuesday at the FilOil Centre in San Juan.
